Nuova. MARGIN IGALILEO
Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection 
 I2 , which must be performed every six months 
 as indicated by M6 in the title block.

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy 
 WEDC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

Safety 
Precautions

A 
work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, 
safety glasses is required.

The circuit breaker must be isolated completely 
and properly earthed from both sides,
DC control power should be disconnected.

Wear breathing 
mask to protect your lung tissues from the dust particles 
before using a blower to clean the control 
cabinet or when cleaning the insulators.

sections.text: Work to be carried out

General 
Procedures

Before putting the 
circuit-breaker into service carry out the following

items:
Check the tightness of the electrical connections on the circuit -breaker 
 terminals.

Establish the setting of the direct solid-state over current relay (if 
 provided).

Check that the value of the supply voltage for the auxiliary circuit is within 
 85% and 110% of the rated voltage of the electrical devices.
Check that no foreign body, such as packing, has got into the moving parts.

sections.text: NOTE

items:
Check that air circulation in the circuit-breaker installation site is 
 adequate so that there is no danger of
 overheating.

Check that the gas pressure is correct. (green lamp on), if not, reset the 
 correct pressure
Carry out the checks indicated in the following table.

sections.text:
Manual 
Operating Mechanism
Carry out a few closing and opening operations to see if the operations and relative signals occur correctly

N.B supply the under voltage relay with the relative rated voltage (if 
provided).
Motor Operating Mechanism

items:
Supply geared motor for spring charging at the relative rated voltage to see 
 if the springs are charged correctly if the signal are correct the geared 
 motor cuts off when the springs are charged.

Carry out a few closing and opening operations, the geared motor recharges the 
 springs after each closing operation

sections.text:

provided)

Under Voltage Relay 
 (If Provided)

Supply the under voltage release at the relative rated voltage and carry 
 out the circuit-breaker closing operation
 if the circuit-breaker closes correctly the signal changes over

Disconnect the power supply from the release the circuit-breaker opens the 
 signal changes over.

Insert the auxiliary contacts into suitable signaling circuits with the

With a 2500 V megger, measure the insulation resistance between the 
 phase and between phases and exposed conductive part of the medium voltage 
 circuit. The insulation resistance should be at least 50 MO, and in any 
 case. Constant in time if values are different, find out the cause.

With a 500 V megger (installed equipment permitting) measure the 
 insulation resistance between the auxiliary circuits and the exposed 
 conductive part. The insulation resistance should be a few MW 
 and, in any case. Constant in time
